note: Post cache-short-circuit fix baseline. Cache preflight now skips trace scanning for cached passes. Cold-cache numbers reflect the fix; warm-cache cache_short_circuit_passes show the cache-hit deserialization overhead.

cache_policy.rocksdb_index: warm except for the first recovery/open observation
cache_policy.pass_cache_cold: remove pass_cache before each measured run
cache_policy.pass_cache_warm: seed a cache with the current binary, then run three times

trace.name: test_50m.bin
trace.description: Real iOS app trace; 50 MB compressed, 1058 MB logical; footer missing and block index recovered on open

pass_cache_warm.note: Measured after moving persisted-cache deserialization before collector declaration and trace scanning. The total still includes uncached passes such as taint and memory_snapshot, so use per-pass values to evaluate cache short-circuiting.

regression_thresholds.note: Flag when the pass_cache_cold median increases by more than this factor. Re-measure three runs under the same build/features/cache policy.

legacy.v3.1_note: Pre-fix baseline: cache preflight was not yet implemented; cold-cache runs still did full trace scanning even for cached passes. sum_own_median was 31104 ms.
legacy.v2_note: v2 mixed warm persisted-cache timings with older pass topology (including symbol_annotation and separate constant_materialization), so it is retained only as historical context and is not directly comparable to v3.
